experience.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
bullets: Designed and validated CAD models for injection-molded components, reducing prototype iteration cycles by streamlining tolerance stack-up analysis.

Mentored two junior engineers on GD&T standards and DFM best practices.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Technician
bullets: Performed statistical process control audits across three production lines, flagging deviations before they reached shipment.
Developed a lightweight inspection checklist that shortened line changeover downtime.
